units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 232px crest-to-sole body. Pelvis and planted soles provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: Harmonic Precentors: 56 original frames across eight clips reviewed in Godot at 128px. Articulated hands/chimes, complete tuning-fork windup, distinct ranged release/recoil, staff brace, consistent conducting-hand ownership, reciprocal walk and grounded collapse. Malformed fork, switched hand and alpha-joined ranged proposals excluded; original art and provenance preserved.
